abstract: OBJECTIVE: Much debate exists on the initiation of chemotherapy for women at risk for persistent gestational trophoblastic disease. This is a result of a lack of early predictors for the development of persistent gestational trophoblastic disease after evacuation of a complete hydatidiform mole, because the only current reliable method of detection and diagnosis lies in persistent or rising postmolar beta-human chorionic gonadotropin values. We used immunocytochemical techniques to retrospectively study the expression of the c-erb B-2 oncogene product in formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded trophoblastic tissues as a potential indicator of the development of persistent gestational trophoblastic disease. STUDY DESIGN: In this retrospective study 56 trophoblastic tumors were examined by means of immunocytochemical techniques to stain for the oncogene product for evidence of c-erb B-2 expression. Our 56 cases included original tissue from 20 cases of complete mole that progressed to persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, seven cases of choriocarcinoma after term pregnancy or abortion, and 29 cases of hydatidiform mole representing postevacuation, spontaneously regressing disease (including one partial mole). We also studied 11 cases of first-trimester trophoblast and 15 cases of term placenta as additional controls. RESULTS: Our results showed positive immunostaining for c-erb B-2 gene product in one case of persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, with negative staining in all other cases in the study groups and controls. CONCLUSION: Analysis for the significance of c-erb B-2 expression in persistent gestational trophoblastic disease showed that this correlation between c-erb B-2 expression and persistent gestational trophoblastic disease is not significant, suggesting that future efforts should be directed at the involvement of different oncoproteins.
abstract_ja: 目的：胞状奇胎の完全除去後に持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症する危険がある女性において、化学療法を開始する時期については議論が多い。これは、胞状奇胎後の持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症を早期に予測する指標が乏しいためである。現在、信頼できる検出・診断の唯一の方法は、胞状奇胎後の持続性または上昇するβ-hCG値である。我々は、ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋の絨毛性腫瘍組織におけるc-erbB-2癌遺伝子産物の発現を、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症の指標として免疫細胞化学的手法で後方視的に検討した。研究デザイン：本後方視的研究では、56例の絨毛性腫瘍を免疫細胞化学的手法でc-erbB-2発現について検査した。対象症例には、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患へ進行した完全奇胎20例、正期妊娠または流産後の絨毛癌7例、自然退縮した胞状奇胎（部分奇胎1例を含む）29例が含まれた。対照として、妊娠初期の栄養膜11例と正期胎盤15例も検討した。結果：c-erbB-2遺伝子産物の陽性免疫染色は、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の1例でのみ認められ、その他の研究群および対照群はすべて陰性であった。結論：持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるc-erbB-2発現との関連は有意ではなく、今後は他の癌蛋白の関与を検討すべきであることが示唆された。
